papers.title: On the Calibration of Isotonic Distributional Regression
papers.reading_depth: abstract and selectedsections1,2,4 through pool-block rational-PIT explanation;not whole empirical/proof/smoothing study
papers.takeaway_paraphrase: A recent IDR-specific study distinguishes in-sample threshold calibration from out-of-sample randomized-PIT behavior and explains rational spikes from PAV blocks. This does not prove a calibration failure of our different forest/spline model. It supports keeping exact discrete PIT intervals and avoiding uniformity claims from midpoint histograms.
